class.name: GLTFMesh
class.description: GLTFMesh handles 3D mesh data imported from glTF files. It includes properties for blend channels, blend weights, instance materials, and the mesh itself.

members.member: An array of floats representing the blend weights of the mesh.
An array of Material objects representing the materials used in the mesh.
The [ImporterMesh] object representing the mesh itself.
The original name of the mesh.
